violations.message: Container shares a host namespace — breaks isolation
Container runs privileged — full host access
violations.suggestion: Drop privileged and grant only the capabilities needed

violations.message: [EXPOSED_BIND]: hostPort publishes the service on every node interface
violations.suggestion: Drop hostPort and expose the pod through a Service
Use environment variables or a secrets manager; never hardcode credentials

violations.message: Debug output enabled — leaks stack traces and configuration
violations.suggestion: Guard behind an environment check and disable it outside development

violations.message: Weak hash algorithm — MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security use
violations.suggestion: Use SHA-256 or better; for passwords use bcrypt, scrypt or Argon2

violations.message: Untrusted data deserialized into arbitrary objects — remote code execution risk
violations.suggestion: Use a data-only format (JSON) with an explicit schema, or restrict allowed types

violations.message: SQL query built with f-string — SQL injection risk
violations.suggestion: Use parameterized queries or sanitize/escape all external input

violations.message: eval()/exec() runs dynamic code — code injection risk
violations.suggestion: Use parameterized queries or sanitize/escape all external input

violations.message: Sensitive field written to a log or console — secrets persist in log storage
violations.suggestion: Log an identifier or a masked value instead of the secret itself

violations.message: Sleep used to order threads — race prone; synchronize explicitly
violations.suggestion: Protect shared state with a lock or use an immutable/atomic alternative

violations.message: File or socket opened outside a with block
violations.suggestion: Use a with statement so the handle closes on every path

violations.message: [PATH_TRAVERSAL]: read_report opens a caller-supplied path without validation
violations.suggestion: Resolve the path and require it to stay under the reports directory

violations.message: Division by variable `count` without zero check — ZeroDivisionError risk
violations.suggestion: Guard with `if count == 0` or use try/except ZeroDivisionError
Log the exception or re-raise; never silently swallow

violations.message: User-controlled variable interpolated directly into prompt f-string — prompt injection risk
violations.suggestion: Sanitize or validate user input before including in prompts; use structured slots, not raw interpolation
